The '''''Eclipse''''' was a [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnought]] belonging to the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] that was present during the [[Battle of Corellia]] in [[3640 BBY]]. The corrupted [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tol Braga]] attempted to detonate the cruiser's engines above [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City's]] [[Governmental Sector|Government District]], but the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]] stopped Braga and deactivated the engines.

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Eclipse.png|left|150px|The original ''Eclipse'']]
The ''Eclipse'' appears in the Jedi Knight class mission "Mutual Assured Destruction", although it is visible to all classes atop a building in Capitol Square. Prior to Game Update 2.0 of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', the ''Eclipse'' was erroneously depicted as a large [[Imperial military transport]] with altered dimensions, while a holo-image of the ship during "Mutual Assured Destruction" correctly showed a [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnought]] linked to a docking tower.
